children.title: Newbuilding Prices
children.summary: Second Hand (5 Yr) Values There is a strong relationship between newbuilding prices and second hand values. Normally there is a discount between the two reflecting the age difference, but in strong markets, having a ship is better than waiting for a ship 18 or more months after it has been ordered.

children.title: Newbuilding Prices
children.summary: 1 Yr Timecharter 3 Yr Timecharter While not quite as strong as the relationship between newbuilding prices and second hand values, there was a strong family resemblance between the three up to last year. The logic of the relationship is that a strong market drives up term charter rates, which in turn increases owners' desires for new tonnage.

children.title: Caribs Upcoast
children.summary: 1 Yr Timecharter 3 Yr Timecharter The relationship is relatively weak because the term charter market is not nearly as volatile as spot rates, although one can see that term charter rates follow the general trend in spot rates.

children.title: Summary
children.summary: If we treat R Square values above 95% as a very strong (VS) relationship, 85-90% as a strong relationship (S), 50-85% as a moderately strong relationship (MS), 40-50% as moderately weak (MW) and anything below 40% as weak (W), then the Aframax family tree is:
